name: gta6-by-the-numbers
caption: GTA 6 is shaping up to be the biggest entertainment launch in history. 🌴 Which number surprised you most? 👇 Follow @leonidatips for daily GTA 6 news, tips & the countdown to launch.

slides.headline: *GTA 6* is coming. Here's why it'll be the *biggest* game in *history*.
The first trailer hit *93 million* views in *24 hours* — a record for any non-music video.
GTA 6 is reportedly the most *expensive* game ever made — estimates run into the *billions*.
Release date: *November 19, 2026*. Launching on *PS5* and *Xbox Series X|S*.
The map is the *biggest* Rockstar has ever built — a modern Vice City in the state of *Leonida*.
For the first time ever, you play as a *duo* — *Lucia* and *Jason*.
Analysts expect GTA 6 to break every *sales record* — possibly *$1 billion* in just *days*.
Follow *@leonidatips* for daily GTA 6 news, tips & the *countdown*.
